source_name: Академија за судии и јавни обвинители (JP Academy) — training materials on administrative disputes
why_relevant: Judicial-training materials explain how administrative disputes against regulators actually run (costs, standing, timelines) — background needed to interpret court output and to judge how likely supervisory decisions are to be challenged.

source_name: Стопанска комора — Асоцијација на осигурително-брокерски друштва
why_relevant: 35 insurance brokerage firms; adjacent-sector association whose positions on distribution/consumer-protection rules often travel with bancassurance and financial-services consultations.

source_name: Duna Computers (ULTIMA ERP, fiscal devices) — MK IT vendor
why_relevant: Major MK integrator and fiscal-cash-register manufacturer; relevant to the fiscalisation/e-invoicing (е-Фактура) mandate that intersects bank payment services and merchant acquiring. Corporate/LinkedIn announcements can flag which financial or merchant-acquiring counterparties adopt what.

Business information/database service with news layer; potentially useful for company-level context around licensed payment institutions and financial companies mentioned in regulatory news. Lower priority — commercial database rather than a regulatory news desk.

source_name: European Parliament — Western Balkans / North Macedonia annual resolutions and fact sheets
why_relevant: The EP's annual report on North Macedonia and the OEIL procedure files add political pressure points and sometimes name specific financial-sector shortcomings; useful as a second, independent EU-side read on alignment pace.

source_name: Finelevate Digital Summit (Skopje, 16 Sept 2026) — conference agenda
why_relevant: Business conference on the future of digital finance for the banking, insurance and fintech sectors in Skopje; announced topics explicitly include regulatory compliance (регулаторна усогласеност), payment innovation, digital identity, cyber security and data modernisation. Its agenda and speaker roster is a direct read on which mandates institutions are staffing for in 2026-27.

source_name: mkopen.org – third-party mirror/catalogue of .gov.mk open data
why_relevant: Independent catalogue/mirror of Macedonian government open datasets — a fallback when data.gov.mk is unreachable (as it was in this run) and a way to see datasets that were later withdrawn from the official portal.

Daily with an economy desk that covers banking and finance; candidate redundancy channel for supervisory news. Included from outlet knowledge and cell scope; not confirmed by an article hit in this run — verify before promoting.
